import re, zlib
F = "aaa bbb ccc ddd eeee ffff gggg hhhh"
def score(program):
    w = set(re.findall(r"\w{6,}", program))
    if not w:
        return 0.5
    h = sorted(zlib.crc32(x.encode()) % 9973 / 9973 for x in w)
    return sum(h[:3]) / 3

import re, zlib
K = 'def return for if else while in not and or import lambda len'.split()
def score(program):
    w = re.findall(r'\w+', program)
    t = [k for k in K if k in w]
    return zlib.crc32(str(t).encode()) % 1000 / 999
